children: SBIN posted Q2 FY2026-27 net profit of Rs.23,037 crore, up 14.28% year over year, and net interest income rose 14.69% to Rs.49,143 crore. Shares gained 0.95% to Rs.978.85.

After Q2 FY27 results, analysts were split on SBIN. CLSA kept Outperform with a Rs 1,325 target; Citi retained Buy at Rs 1,300. HSBC cut its target to Rs 1,220, while UBS and Nomura stayed Neutral.
State Bank of India Sponsored GDR RegS (SBIN) reported profit after tax of Rs 230 billion, broadly in line with estimates. Emkay Global Financial retained its Buy rating and target price of Rs 1,350.
